title: Eval-harness trigger API: run quality gates for Optimize config diffs vs baseline
creator: Olivia Grant
description:
Problem
Optimize will propose runtime config changes (batching policy, prefix/KV caching settings, quantization profile changes). Before these diffs can be applied (one-click or auto-apply), we must run mandatory quality gates and return a structured, auditable result to the Optimize service + Console.

Today eval-harness can run suites for model/version changes, but does not have a first-class contract for:
- Accepting a config diff ("candidate") + baseline config ("control")
- Selecting/recording the correct baseline for a given model family + hardware SKU
- Returning normalized score deltas + artifacts pointers that Optimize can persist and display

Scope
Implement/extend eval-harness API endpoints to:
1) Trigger an eval run given (a) config diff, (b) baseline selection input, (c) gate tier (smoke/full), (d) prompt set selection.
2) Return structured results including per-metric deltas, variance/confidence metadata, and artifact locations.
3) Provide idempotency + status polling for long-running jobs and retries.

Non-goals (this ticket)
- Defining the actual metric thresholds (owned by Applied ML)
- Optimize-side persistence/state machine (ENG-3921)
- Console UI rendering (ENG-3925)

Proposed API (v1)
All endpoints behind existing internal service auth (mTLS + service-to-service JWT), same as other eval-harness runners.

1) POST /v1/gates/runs
Trigger a new gate run. Returns a stable gate_run_id and initial status.

Request fields (logical)
- request_id: caller-generated UUID for idempotency (required)
- gate_tier: "smoke" | "full" (required)
- change_type: "batching" | "caching" | "quantization" (required)
- model_ref: model name + pinned version (required)
- hardware_ref: sku + region (required for quantization; optional otherwise)
- baseline:
  - baseline_config_id OR baseline_policy (e.g., "current_production") (required)
- candidate:
  - config_diff: typed diff blob (required)
- prompt_sets:
  - prompt_set_ids OR prompt_set_policy (e.g., "optimize_gating_default") (required)
- eval_profile:
  - max_cost_usd (optional)
  - timeout_seconds (optional)
  - concurrency (optional)

Response fields (logical)
- gate_run_id
- status: pending|running|completed|failed
- status_url: /v1/gates/runs/{gate_run_id}
- created_at

2) GET /v1/gates/runs/{gate_run_id}
Poll status and retrieve final results.

Response fields (logical)
- gate_run_id
- status
- started_at / finished_at
- input_summary (hashes/ids only; avoid echoing raw prompts)
- results_summary:
  - verdict: pass|fail|inconclusive
  - flake_score (0-1)
  - rerun_count
  - metrics: normalized list of metric rows (metric_name, baseline_value, candidate_value, delta, delta_pct, ci_lower, ci_upper, n)
  - failures: reason codes + human-readable messages
- artifacts:
  - artifact_ids / artifact_urls for: raw outputs, rubric annotations, per-prompt diffs, aggregated report
- logs:
  - run_log_url (optional)

3) POST /v1/gates/runs/{gate_run_id}:cancel (optional)
Best-effort cancellation to manage GPU scarcity / bad inputs.

Contract decisions
- Versioning: include X-Redwood-EvalContract: "gates.v1" header; breaking changes require gates.v2.
- Idempotency: request_id must be respected for 24h; return the same gate_run_id for duplicates.
- Artifact storage: use existing artifact backend; return stable IDs + pre-signed URLs (URLs may expire; IDs must not).
- Prompt privacy: eval-harness should only return prompt set IDs and hashes in input_summary (no raw prompt text in the API response).
- Result normalization: metrics must be returned as a flat list (not nested per suite) so Optimize can compute deltas/threshold checks consistently.

Implementation notes
- Reuse existing job runner primitives (queue + GPU workers). The new run type should map to a "gating" runner that executes:
  - Baseline run (control)
  - Candidate run (treatment)
  - Aggregation step (deltas + CI + verdict)
- Baseline resolution:
  - If baseline_config_id provided: use it
  - If baseline_policy provided: resolve via Optimize-provided baseline id (preferred), but allow eval-harness-side fallback only for internal testing. (We do not want eval-harness owning production baseline semantics long-term.)
- Static validation:
  - Reject obviously invalid diffs early (missing required knobs, unknown fields) using the shared config-diff schema (ENG-3930 / PR-19511).
- Retry policy:
  - Transient infra failures: retry up to 2 times per suite; surface rerun_count.
  - "Inconclusive" verdict if variance too high / n too low; do not auto-pass.

Acceptance criteria
- Optimize can trigger a gate run with config diff + baseline reference and receive a gate_run_id.
- Gate run status is pollable; terminal status includes pass/fail/inconclusive verdict.
- Response includes normalized per-metric deltas with CI bounds and sample sizes.
- Artifacts are persisted and returned as stable IDs; Optimize can link them in Console.
- Idempotency works (duplicate request_id returns same gate_run_id) and does not enqueue duplicate GPU work.
- P95 API response time (trigger endpoint) < 250ms excluding auth; job execution time is out of scope but must be observable.

Testing
- Unit tests for request validation, idempotency behavior, and result normalization.
- Integration test in eval-harness repo: spin up worker stub, run a small prompt set, verify artifacts + metrics.
- Contract test fixture: golden JSON response samples for pass/fail/inconclusive.

Rollout
- Ship behind feature flag "gates_api_v1" in eval-harness.
- Enable for internal Optimize staging first.
- Coordinate with ENG-3921 to flip Optimize to the new endpoint in staging, then prod.

- Confluence: applied-ml-and-evals/eval-harness/gating-integration-contracts.json
- GitHub: eval-harness PR-412 (trigger endpoint)

Progress / updates
- 2025-12-02 (Olivia): Drafted endpoints + response normalization proposal; shared with Jonas/Selene for metrics shape.
- 2025-12-09 (Jonas Weber): Confirmed metric rows need CI + n; asked to include per-suite breakdown in artifacts (not in API payload).
- 2025-12-15 (Sahana Iyer): Requested request_id idempotency to prevent GPU double-spend during Optimize retries.
- 2026-01-07 (Olivia): Implemented /v1/gates/runs and /v1/gates/runs/{id}; integrated with job runner; added artifact IDs.
- 2026-01-23: Merged and enabled in staging. Optimize integration unblocked.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Do we need a webhook/callback to reduce polling load? (Likely v2; for now polling is acceptable.)
- Should eval-harness calculate thresholds/verdict, or should Optimize? Current plan: eval-harness returns deltas + variance; Optimize evaluates thresholds (defense-in-depth). We still return a coarse verdict for debugging, but Optimize is the enforcement source of truth.
- Regional execution: should gate runs execute in the same region as the target route (EU-West timeouts noted)? Track separately under SRE capacity planning.
